rows.definition: The guard rung that decides what to do when an agent stops for lack of local hardware, folding hwgatelint findings through the off|shadow|warn|enforce ladder.
rows.distinction: The DECISION RUNG (off|shadow|warn|enforce ladder) - NOT hwgatelint (the text scanner that detects the stops) and NOT gitgate (the git-command prefilter).

rows.definition: The sensor package (internal/hwgatelint) that scans agent final-output text for local-hardware stop patterns and returns sanctioned-compute-node redirects.
rows.distinction: The SENSOR (text scanner that detects stop patterns) - NOT hwgate (the decision rung that folds its findings into off|shadow|warn|enforce) and NOT gitgate (the git-command prefilter).

rows.definition: A gateway-level gate (internal/gateway) that checks declared completion evidence at a model-final boundary before allowing a stop to finalize.
rows.distinction: A GATEWAY completion-boundary gate (checks model-stop evidence) - NOT the guard stop hook (the guard's post-turn stop logic) and NOT a git-hook gate (commit boundary).

rows.definition: The fak guard-stops subcommand that folds the guard's stop-history ledger into a tally for the soak to promote read.
rows.distinction: An operator-facing TALLY TOOL (folds the stop ledger) - NOT guardStopDisposition (the typed outcome vocabulary each stop carries) and NOT the guard stop hook (the hook that produces stops).

rows.definition: The gitgate rung (internal/gitgate/sweepguard.go) that classifies each dirty hunk a path-scoped git op would sweep as OWNED-by-self/OWNED-by-peer/SHARED/ORPHAN and refuses the irrecoverable ORPHAN case.
rows.distinction: An ATTRIBUTION-AWARE sweep guard (prevents sweeping a peer's WIP) - NOT gitgate (the general git-command prefilter) and NOT trunk-guard (the branch-state policy).

rows.definition: A closed-vocabulary refusal-reason CATEGORY that routes a stop to the operator instead of auto-replanning (RELAY_NO_PROGRESS, RELAY_PARKED_UNSAFE, UNTIERED_LEAF).
rows.distinction: A REASON CATEGORY (operator must intervene, no auto-replan) - NOT a gate TYPE (a decision point) and NOT guardrail (the safety-boundary concept).

rows.definition: The closed set of typed terminal outcomes the guard stop hook can produce (hardware_gate_continue, hardware_gate_warn, hardware_gate_shadow, operator_directed, etc.).
rows.distinction: The typed OUTCOME VOCABULARY (one value per stop) - NOT guard-stops (the tally command that folds them) and NOT the guard stop hook (the hook that emits them).
